title: Purpose of the Epistle
english: In this letter, he writes to clergy, not to the laity; for this reason, he did not need more of the unrighteous, but rather he intended through the letter that the state of humility might be perfected in them. Through this exhortation, he shows the precision of the other life. For rarely does anyone both sin and become puffed up; for the one who is puffed up flies away from those living the most beautiful lives, and instead, is most often puffed up by this very thing.

Everywhere and through all things my sufferings and my defenses are shown to be not unprofitable (Phil 1:7). From your faith I make a proof, your standing.
